label_rationale: deposit credits the stake from credited = poolBalance - snap measured across token.transferFrom; a crafted token re-enters deposit so the same incoming balance is credited to two deposits (fake-token double-count)
mechanism: Paraluni (Mar 2022): masterchef deposit reentrancy via a crafted token whose transferFrom re-enters deposit; stake credited from a pool delta. No public patched version; vulnerable-only.
arm_reason: a state-changing callback with a user/frozen target; the general assume-guarantee arm applies

closure.justification: functions whose read/write effects intersect the proof footprint ['amountOf', 'poolBalance', 'totalStaked']

composition.rule: admissible callbacks preserve I_exp; the post-phase restores I_stable, which implies phi

Assume-Guarantee specification for ParaluniChefVuln
  target property phi : totalStaked <= poolBalance
  exposure site       : deposit.transferFrom  (external interface call)
  ghost state         : (none)

  [A_cb]  ASSUMPTION
          During deposit's exposed phase, re-entrant control is confined to the
          callback closure ['deposit']; every such callback is admitted by the
          protocol, with bounded depth-one nesting.
          discharged by: conservative-closure soundness gate (static, not the LLM)

  [G_pre] GUARANTEE
          {totalStaked <= poolBalance} pre-phase {totalStaked <= poolBalance}
          discharged by: OBL_pre

  [G_exp] GUARANTEE
          forall f in A_cb. {I_exp} f {I_exp}   (I_exp = totalStaked <= poolBalance)
          discharged by: ['OBL_cb_deposit']

  [G_post] GUARANTEE
          {I_exp} post-phase {totalStaked <= poolBalance /\ true}
          discharged by: OBL_post

  COMPOSITION THEOREM (instance):
    A_cb => (G_pre /\ G_exp /\ G_post) => totalStaked <= poolBalance
      where callbacks are confined to admissible_callbacks=['deposit'], depth-one
